SDAS STAR CITIZEN CALENDAR

Some Dudes and a Spaceship now has its own live Star Citizen calendar.

Just open your calendar and see what’s coming.

# 🚀 ORG NEWS | OUR WEBSITE IS LIVE! 🌐
**Some Dudes and a Spaceship officially has its own website!**
🌐 **https://sdas.space/**
That's right, gentlemen! SDAS is expanding beyond Discord and into its own little corner of the internet.
What started as a group of dudes looking for good company and adventures in the 'verse continues to grow, and now we've got a place on the web to call our own!
### 🛰️ WHAT'S THE WEBSITE FOR?
Our website serves as the **official online home of Some Dudes and a Spaceship**, giving our organization a presence outside of Discord and helping more Star Citizen players discover our community.

items.title: ***A Message About Our Org***
items.body:
It's come to my attention that some members may have concerns that SDAS has become more of a pirate organization lately. I want to take a moment to clear a few things up and explain where we stand as an Org.
**First and foremost, SDAS is NOT a pirate Org.**
SDAS was founded on a simple idea: to create a community where anyone can come together, meet cool people, make friends, and have fun playing Star Citizen. That means **ALL game loops**, whether it's mining, salvaging, cargo hauling, PvE, PvP, exploration, or yes, even piracy.
Piracy does happen within SDAS. I'm not going to pretend it doesn't. However, it happens far less frequently than some people might think. And when it does happen,

items.title: **I will not build or restrict SDAS around one singular playstyle, regardless of how strongly some people may feel about
items.body:
I also want to say this: if you're avoiding joining Org nights or hanging out with members simply because you've heard that some people participate in piracy, you're missing out on a genuinely awesome group of people.
SDAS has some of the most helpful, generous, and downright hilarious individuals I've ever met in the verse. I've seen people go out of their way to help other members with absolutely nothing to gain for themselves, simply because that's what we do here.
And I don't want anyone overlooking that side of this community.
